summary: This 8-K filed by Atmos Energy Corp. reports the entry into an underwriting agreement for a public offering of $700 million aggregate principal amount of 4.750% Senior Notes due 2032. The offering is an ordinary debt capital markets transaction under an existing shelf registration, not a special situation. Underwriters are J.P. Morgan, Mizuho, and Wells Fargo. Net proceeds are approximately $693.9 million after discounts and expenses. Close is expected on June 18, 2026, subject to customary conditions. No change of control, activist campaign, strategic review, or restructuring is implicated.
